name: Bazda's Artifact
description: A crescent-shaped carved stone with golden symbols, found by Bazda's father at the basilica, that completes the coin mill.

timeline.summary: Bazda shows Terrik an ancient crescent artifact her father found at the basilica, and Terrik promises to have Ambrellin look at it.
timeline.quote: My father gave me this a couple days before he died.

timeline.summary: Ambrellin identifies Bazda's artifact as ancient Izzet technology and calls it priceless.
timeline.quote: I've seen them before on ancient Izzet machinery

timeline.summary: Bazda secretly passes her artifact to Terrik as the pontiff searches the prisoners.
timeline.quote: Her quick thieving hands had planted it on me without me even noticing.

pages_say.description: A crescent-shaped carved stone with golden symbols, found by Bazda's father at the basilica, that completes the coin mill.
